important_dates.written test (tentative): Fourth week of October 2026, at BEL Ghaziabad

application_fee.details: The application fee is not specified in the official notification. Candidates should check the NATS portal (nats.education.gov.in) directly for any fee-related instructions at the time of registration/application.

age_limit.details: Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

qualification.details: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. The candidate should have passed their Diploma in one of the above-mentioned engineering branches, recognised by AICTE or a GOI-approved institute, on or after 01.07.2023. Candidates who have already completed their apprenticeship, terminated their apprenticeship mid-way, or are currently pursuing an apprenticeship with another organisation are not eligible. Candidates who have acquired or are pursuing a higher qualification (beyond the Diploma) are not eligible. Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/PWD/EWS and other categories will be as per Government guidelines.

Electronics (Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electronics and Telecommunication, Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering)

salary_details.details: Selected Diploma Apprentices will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 12,500/-, payable as per the Apprentices Act, 1961 (as amended), across all four engineering trades. Canteen facilities will be available on a chargeable basis during the training period.

selection_process: Selection will be based on the merit of the percentage of marks obtained by the candidate in a Written Test conducted by BEL Ghaziabad. The written test will tentatively be held in the fourth week of October 2026 at BEL Ghaziabad. Shortlisted candidates will be informed for the written test through their registered email ID.

Important: Percentage of marks in the Engineering Diploma Examination is mandatory. Candidates are advised to compulsorily enter their percentage of marks/CGPA in the relevant column on the NATS portal. If the percentage of marks is not furnished
the candidature will not be considered.
how_to_apply: BEL Ghaziabad Diploma Apprentice Apply Online is done entirely through the NATS portal (nats.education.gov.in), operated by BOAT. Candidates who have not yet enrolled in the National Web Portal should follow the steps below.
Complete the application form. A unique Enrolment Number will be generated for each student.
Search for "Bharat Electronics Limited-Ghaziabad" under "Apply against advertised vacancies."
Click "Apply." (You will see confirmation that you have successfully applied for the vacancy.)

Candidates can apply for the above vacancies through the NATS portal from 07.09.2026 till 25.09.2026. Interested candidates should register on BOAT's portal; applications received after the last date (25.09.2026) will not be considered.
important_instructions: Percentage of marks (or CGPA) in the Engineering Diploma Examination is mandatory and must be entered on the NATS portal; candidature will not be considered if this is not furnished. Candidates should be prepared with their Diploma qualification details, date of passing, and category certificates (SC/ST/OBC/PWD/EWS), as applicable, for entry on the NATS portal. For queries related to student enrollment on the Web Portal, contact: natssupport_student@aicte_india.org.

Only candidates who fulfil all the eligibility criteria are eligible to apply. The duration of the apprenticeship training is one year, and during this period candidates will be governed by the Apprentices Act, 1961, as well as the policies/rules of the organisation. The number of vacancies to be engaged is indicative and may be changed by Management without any further notification and without assigning any reason. BEL Ghaziabad has no obligation to give regular employment to apprentices. Apprentices will have no right to claim regular employment from BEL Ghaziabad on the basis of this apprenticeship at any point of time. This training programme creates no liability on BEL Ghaziabad to provide a job to the apprentice, and BEL Ghaziabad management does not take any responsibility for employment/placement. All matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection, and cancellation of the selection process (in part or full) will be at the final and binding decision of Management. No correspondence will be entertained in this regard. If some seats are not filled due to unsuitability or an insufficient number of candidates, filling up the seats is solely at the discretion of Management based on the suitability of candidates, and no claim for engagement will arise. BEL Ghaziabad does not take any responsibility for responding to candidates regarding non-selection or non-issuance of a call/engagement letter. Suppression of facts or furnishing false information will lead to disqualification/rejection of candidature. For any information or query, contact only through email: [email protected]. No other medium of communication will be entertained for any query.

faq.question: Q1. What is BEL Ghaziabad Diploma Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notification by Bharat Electronics Limited, Ghaziabad Unit, to engage 38 Diploma Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961, for one year of apprenticeship training in Mechanical, Computer Science, Electronics and Civil Engineering trades.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in BEL Ghaziabad Diploma Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 38 indicative vacancies: 10 in Mechanical Engineering, 11 in Computer Science, 12 in Electronics, and 5 in Civil Engineering.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for BEL Ghaziabad Diploma Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window is open from 07 September 2026 to 25 September 2026, through the NATS portal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for BEL Ghaziabad Diploma Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science (or related branches), Electronics (or related branches), or Civil Engineering, recognised by AICTE or a GOI-approved institute, passed on or after 01.07.2023.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for BEL Ghaziabad Diploma Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 21 years as on 01.08.2026, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 10 years for PWD candidates.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for BEL Ghaziabad Diploma Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must register and apply through the NATS portal (nats.education.gov.in), searching for "Bharat Electronics Limited-Ghaziabad" under advertised vacancies, between 07 September and 25 September 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for BEL Ghaziabad Diploma Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on merit of the percentage of marks obtained in a Written Test conducted by BEL Ghaziabad, tentatively scheduled for the fourth week of October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the stipend for BEL Ghaziabad Diploma Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 12,500/-, as per the Apprentices Act, 1961 (as amended).
